summary: Cameco filed a Form 6-K with a press release commenting on the US DOE's conditional commitment for a $17.5 billion loan to Westinghouse (which Cameco co-owns with Brookfield) to finance long-lead items for up to 10 AP1000 reactors. No stake, price/share, or premium is stated. The filing does not announce a direct corporate transaction for Cameco itself; it is a reaction to an external government initiative. The mechanics involve an SPV administering loan funding, with partners committing ~$500M each per project. No deal terms are disclosed. What to watch: loan documentation and final investment decisions.
